title: Bnpm Manifest
description: Schema for bnpm.toml — the Bnpm package manifest file. Defines package identity, typed conditional exports, dependency declarations with capability grants, runtime capabilities, declarative build steps, AI-native metadata, and workspace configuration.

package.title: Package Identity
package.description: Core package metadata block. Every bnpm.toml must have this section.

name.description: Package name, optionally scoped (@scope/name). Lowercase, hyphenated, no leading dots.

version.description: Semantic version string (semver). Must be valid semver per semver.org.

description.description: Human-readable one-line description of the package.
examples: Typed, retrying HTTP client with pluggable transports

license.description: SPDX license expression. A single identifier or compound expression (MIT OR Apache-2.0). Validated against the SPDX license list at publish time.

repository.description: URL to the canonical source repository.

items.description: Runtime constraint expression, e.g. node>=20, deno>=2, bun>=1.2, workerd.

runtime.description: Declared runtime support matrix. The resolver uses this to filter incompatible packages.

type.description: Module system type. Bnpm is exclusively ESM; 'module' is the only valid value. CJS is supported only through the npm compat bridge.

private.description: If true, the package is private (not published to the registry). Used for workspace root packages.

exports.title: Conditional Exports
exports.description: Typed conditional entry points. Keys are export subpaths ('.' for the main entry, './foo' for deep exports). Nested subpath exports are the only way to expose package entry points — deep imports into package internals are forbidden.

additionalProperties.title: Export Conditions
additionalProperties.description: Condition map for an export subpath. The 'types' condition is always resolved first; the runtime chooses the first matching condition from left to right.

types.description: Path to TypeScript type declaration file (.d.ts).

require.description: Path to CJS entry point for npm compat bridge (.cjs, .js).

default.description: Default fallback entry point when no other condition matches.

development.description: Development-only entry point (with dev warnings, hot reload).

production.description: Production-only entry point (optimized, no dev code).

dependencies.title: Dependencies
dependencies.description: Production dependencies. Keys are un-scoped or scoped package names. Values are either a version range string or a dependency object with optional singleton, grants, and optional flags.

oneOf.description: Simple version range. Supports npm-style ranges: ^1.0, >=2.0 <3.0, ~1.2, 1.4.2, *.

singleton.description: If true, the resolver enforces that only one version of this package exists in the graph. Used for packages with global state (React, etc.). Default: false (graph-local versioning, multiple majors coexist).

grants.description: Explicit capability grants this dependency receives. Install fails if the consumer's policy forbids these grants.

registry.description: Alternative registry URL or name for resolving this dependency. Defaults to the project's configured registry.

optional.description: If true, the dependency is optional — resolution succeeds even if this dependency is not available.

dev-dependencies.title: Dev Dependencies
dev-dependencies.description: Development-only dependencies. Same format as [dependencies]. Not included in the production dependency graph.

peer-dependencies.title: Peer Dependencies
peer-dependencies.description: Peer dependencies that the consumer must provide. Same format as [dependencies] but defaults to optional=true. Enforced by the resolver (must unify to a single version).

singleton.description: If true, must unify to a single version across the graph.

optional.description: If true, absence is not an error.

capabilities.title: Runtime Capabilities
capabilities.description: Capabilities this package requires at runtime. Default: no capabilities (nothing granted). Each capability has an allowlist or is set to false. The package declares what it needs; the consumer's policy decides whether to grant it.

oneOf.description: List of allowed network endpoints (URL prefixes or hosts).

net.description: Network egress capability. URL allowlist, or false to deny all.

oneOf.description: Filesystem read path allowlist. Paths are relative to the project root.

fs-read.description: Filesystem read access. Path allowlist or false.

fs-write.description: Filesystem write access. Path allowlist or false.

items.description: Name of an allowed environment variable.

oneOf.description: Environment variable allowlist. Named variables only.

env.description: Environment variable access. Named variable allowlist or false.

subprocess.description: Subprocess spawn capability. True if the package may spawn child processes. Default: false.

build.title: Build-time Capabilities
build.description: Capabilities during the build phase. Separately scoped from runtime capabilities. Builds are hermetic by default (no network, no arbitrary scripts).

network.description: Network access during build. Default: false (hermetic build).

scripts.description: Arbitrary lifecycle scripts at build time. Always false in Bnpm. Replaced by declarative [build] steps.

build.title: Build Declaration
build.description: Declarative build step that replaces npm lifecycle scripts. A build is a pure function: inputs (source + toolchain) produce outputs (dist). Runs in a hermetic sandbox.

tool.description: Pinned builder tool reference. Can be a built-in (bnpm:tsc, bnpm:wasm, bnpm:node-gyp) or a third-party builder capsule CID. The builder itself is content-addressed and capability-gated.

items.description: Glob pattern matching build input files.

inputs.description: File patterns that constitute build inputs. Used for content-hash caching: if inputs haven't changed, the build is skipped.

items.description: Glob pattern matching build output files.

outputs.description: File patterns for build outputs. Outputs are content-addressed and globally shareable.

target.description: Build target environment. Controls output dialect and optimizations.

ai.description: AI-native metadata block. Validated on publish and indexed by the registry's semantic search. Provides structured surface for agents and semantic queries.

workspace.title: Workspace Configuration
workspace.description: Workspace root configuration for monorepos. Present only in a workspace root bnpm.toml. The resolver treats the whole repo as one graph with one lockfile and one store view.

items.description: Glob pattern or relative path to a workspace member directory.

members.description: List of workspace member paths (globs). Members are resolved as local packages within the same graph.

policy.description: Inline policy configuration. Equivalent to a separate bnpm.policy.toml. Overrides any external policy file for this project.
